name: mai-mcp
description: Multi-project brain MCP server: write-gated decisions, lessons, and memory edges, pinned to one project per server instance.

scripts.build: node scripts/setup-runtime.mjs --check && tsc && node scripts/setup-runtime.mjs --copy && node scripts/stamp-build.mjs
scripts.build:web: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.test: vitest run && npm --prefix frontend run test
